No recognized literal secret/private key, credential-bearing header/URL or signed SAS transfer URL was detected. Native-event data contains ordinary repository/API/profile URLs. Container before/after environment lists contain only color/options/locale/timezone/PATH/version variables; image environment contains PATH/versions. The six credential-assignment-context hits are persist-credentials:false in duplicate workflow copies. Expected code references to private state/stale tokens are not credential values.
archive_review_retained_as_negative_evid.disposition: WITHHELD_FROM_PUBLICATION by the final narrow Root scope despite the clean bounded scan. Negative secret detection is not public archival authorization, general security certification or scientific evidence.
